mostWorthwhile.text: The practice repair and second handoff were most worthwhile: residents checked Moth's advice, repaired the fault and demonstrated that another operator could take over.

leastWorthwhile.text: Stocking and authorizing the cupboard was practical but comparatively predictable.

surprise.text: The practice panel had power while reporting a missing signal, a useful distinction from a simply dead device.

arbitrary.text: Using the fobs on the restored practice panel initially felt unclear; the result explained their role in the second operator's handoff.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical repair details and residents taking responsibility make me curious how their network holds up beyond the rehearsal.
